verses.ar: وَأَرْضَعَتْهُ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أُمُّهُ أَيَّامًا ثُمَّ أَرْضَعَتْهُ ثُوَيْبَةُ الْأَسْلَمِيَّةْ ۞ الَّتِي أَعْتَقَهَا أَبُو لَهَبٍ حِينَ وَافَتْهُ عِنْدَ مِيلَادِهِ عَلَيْهِ الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ بِبُشْرَاهْ ۞ فَأَرْضَعَتْهُ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مَعَ ابْنِهَا مَسْرُوحٍ وَأَبِي سَلَمَةَ وَهِيَ بِهِ حَفِيَّةْ ۞ وَأَرْضَعَتْ قَبْلَهُ حَمْزَةَ الَّذِي حُمِدَ فِي نُصْرَةِ الدِّينِ سُرَاهْ
verses.tr: Wa-arḍaʿat-hu ṣalla Llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallama ummuhu ayyāman thumma arḍaʿat-hu Thuwaybatu l-Aslamiyyah, allatī aʿtaqahā Abū Lahabin ḥīna wāfat-hu ʿinda mīlādihi ʿalayhi ṣ-ṣalātu wa-s-salāmu bi-bushrāh, fa-arḍaʿat-hu ṣalla Llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallama maʿa-bnihā Masrūḥin wa-Abī Salamata wa-hiya bihi ḥafiyyah, wa-arḍaʿat qablahu Ḥamzata lladhī ḥumida fī nuṣrati d-dīni surāh.
verses.en: His mother nursed him, may Allah send prayers and peace upon him, for several days. Then he was nursed by Thuwaybah al-Aslamiyyah, whom Abu Lahab set free when she came to him at the time of his birth, peace and prayers be upon him, bearing the glad tidings. She nursed him, may Allah send prayers and peace upon him, together with her son Masruh and Abu Salamah, and she cared for him devotedly. Before him, she had nursed Hamzah, whose noble efforts in supporting the religion were praised.

verses.ar: وَكَانَ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ تَعَالَى عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَبْعَثُ إِلَيْهَا مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ بِصِلَةٍ وَكِسْوَةٍ هِيَ بِهَا حَرِيَّةْ ۞ إِلَى أَنْ أَوْرَدَ هَيْكَلَهَا رَائِدُ الْمَنُونِ الضَّرِيحَ وَوَارَاهْ ۞ قِيلَ عَلٰى دِينِ قَوْمِهَا الْفِئَةِ الْجَاهِلِيَّةْ ۞ وَقِيلَ أَسْلَمَتْ ۞ أَثْبَتَ الْخِلَافَ ابْنُ مَنْدَهَ وَحَكَاهْ
verses.tr: Wa-kāna ṣalla Llāhu taʿālā ʿalayhi wa-sallama yabʿathu ilayhā mina l-Madīnati bi-ṣilatin wa-kiswatin hiya bihā ḥariyyah, ilā an awrada haykalahā rā'idu l-manūni ḍ-ḍarīḥa wa-wārāh, qīla ʿalā dīni qawmiha l-fi'ati l-jāhiliyyah, wa-qīla aslamat, athbata l-khilāfa-bnu Mandaha wa-ḥakāh.
verses.en: And he, may Allah Most High send prayers and peace upon him, would send her gifts and clothing from Madinah, as she was deserving of such kindness, until the herald of death brought her body to the grave and concealed it therein. It is said that she remained upon the religion of her people, the people of the Age of Ignorance, and it is also said that she embraced Islam. Ibn Mandah recorded and related this difference of opinion.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ أَرْضَعَتْهُ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الْفَتَاةُ حَلِيمَةُ السَّعْدِيَّةْ ۞ وَكَانَ قَدْ رَدَّ كُلٌّ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ ثَدْيَهَا لِفَقْرِهَا وَأَبَاهْ ۞ فَأَخْصَبَ عَيْشُهَا بَعْدَ الْمَحْلِ قَبْلَ الْعَشِيَّةْ
verses.tr: Thumma arḍaʿat-hu ṣalla Llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallama l-fatātu Ḥalīmatu s-Saʿdiyyah, wa-kāna qad radda kullun mina l-qawmi thadyahā li-faqrihā wa-abāh, fa-akhṣaba ʿayshuhā baʿda l-maḥli qabla l-ʿashiyyah.
verses.en: Then the young woman Halimah al-Sadiyyah nursed him, may Allah send prayers and peace upon him. Everyone among the people had rejected her breast because of her poverty and refused it, but her life became prosperous after hardship before the evening had even arrived.

verses.ar: وَدَرَّ ثَدْيَاهَا بِدُرِّ دَرٍّ لَبَنَهُ الْيَمِينُ مِنْهُمَا وَأَلْبَنَ الْآخَرُ أَخَاهْ ۞ وَأَصْبَحَتْ بَعْدَ الْهُزَالِ وَالْفَقْرِ وَالْهُوَالِ غَنِيَّةْ ۞ وَسَمِنَتِ الشَّارِفُ لَدَيْهَا وَالشِّيَاهْ ۞ وَانْجَابَ عَنْ جَانِبِهَا كُلُّ مُلِمَّةٍ وَرَزِيَّةْ ۞ وَطَرَّزَ السَّعْدُ بُرْدَ عَيْشِهَا الْهَنِيِّ وَوَشَاهْ
verses.tr: Wa-darra thadyāhā bi-durri darrin labanahu l-yamīnu minhumā wa-albana l-ākharu akhāh, wa-aṣbaḥat baʿda l-huzāli wa-l-faqri wa-l-huwāli ghaniyyah, wa-saminati sh-shārifu ladayhā wa-sh-shiyāh, wa-njāba ʿan jānibihā kullu mulimmatin wa-raziyyah, wa-ṭarraza s-saʿdu burda ʿayshihā l-haniyyi wa-washāh.
verses.en: Her breasts flowed abundantly with milk, the right one giving its milk to him and the other giving milk to his foster brother. After emaciation, poverty, and hardship, she became prosperous, and the old she-camel and the sheep in her care grew fat. Every hardship and affliction withdrew from her side, and happiness embroidered and adorned the garment of her pleasant life.

verses.ar:
عَطِّرِ اللّٰهُمَّ قَبْرَهُ الْكَرِيمَ بِعَرْفٍ شَذِيٍّ مِنْ صَلَاةٍ وَتَسْلِيمٍ
اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ
verses.tr:
ʿAṭṭiri Llāhumma qabrahu l-karīma bi-ʿarfin shadhiyyin min ṣalātin wa-taslīmin.
Allāhumma ṣalli wa-sallim wa-bārik ʿalayhi.
verses.en:
O Allah, perfume his noble grave with a fragrant scent of prayers and peace.
O Allah, send prayers, peace, and blessings upon him.
